notes: Synthetic stand-in for a handwritten entry: low per-word OCR confidence (simulating uncertain character recognition) but a string that still normalizes/OCR-corrects to a real catalog identity. Verifies OCR confidence survives into overall_confidence (dampening it) even when the name itself resolves cleanly -- NOT a measurement of Google Vision's real handwriting recognition accuracy, which this repository has never tested against a real handwritten image.
